subject: Post-call: LedgerBox LLM ops & SLO commitments
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ledgerbox.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: LedgerBox LLM ops & SLO commitments

Hi Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth from the call. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of pain/goals we heard
- Primary goal: real-time invoice parsing and enrichment for high-throughput ingestion (70–90 requests/sec peak) with single-digit-second end-to-end SLA for document-level inference.
- Pain points: bursty traffic from end-of-month loads, unpredictable tail latency with current provider, and rising TCO driven by token-level billing with no batching.
- Compliance: must run in US-only region with customer-managed KMS; SOC 2 evidence will be required for legal review.

Technical constraints & SLO targets (from the call)
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile document generation (300–400 tokens typical) <= 350 ms for model-forwarding portion; end-to-end (including pre/post processing) <= 2.0s for 90% of requests, <= 5s 99th.
- Throughput: baseline sustained 40 RPS, burst to 90 RPS for short windows (<= 30 minutes).
- KV cache: ability to cache repeated prefixes (expected hit rate 25–35%) to reduce token cost and latency on repeated vendor templates.
- Model requirements: open LLM variant (quantized) that supports streaming and structured output (JSON schema). Customer prefers a 7B-13B open checkpoint compatible with Redwood quantization profile.
- Deployment preference: Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) for predictable throughput; fallback to Hosted variant in a secondary region for DR.

Immediate next steps we committed to
1) Redwood to provide: capacity sketch (GPU instance count + burst runway) + estimated committed cost range (attached ledgerbox-kvcache-estimates.xlsx). Target delivery: 48 hours.
2) Redwood infra/ops: a one-page runbook for canary rollout and automatic fallback policy (we attached redwood-deploy-ops-checklist.pdf).
3) LedgerBox: confirm expected monthly QPS profile and any compliance addenda.
4) Legal/procurement: LedgerBox to share contracting timeline and PO requirements.

Open/technical questions for follow-up
- Are there any additional transformation steps that should be in-host vs. upstream (we assumed lightweight tokenization + metadata attach inside customer pipeline)?
- Any hard requirement on max token budget per document? We used 512 tokens in our cost sketch but can adjust.
- Can LedgerBox provide a sample of a heavy-day request trace for sizing? (preferably anonymized)

Attachments (sent): redwood-deploy-ops-checklist.pdf (canary steps, rollback, metrics), ledgerbox-kvcache-estimates.xlsx (capacity/cost sketch), slo-latency-sample-traces.zip (synthetic traces we used for initial sim).

Proposed timeline
- 48h: capacity + cost sketch to Priya
- 1 week: follow-up technical deep-dive with infra + CS to lock canary numbers and SLO buckets
- 2–3 weeks: procurement + SOC2 evidence exchange to start Dedicated onboarding

If that all looks correct I’ll schedule the deep-dive for next Tuesday and share a calendar invite.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ledgerbox.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerBox Engineering <eng@ledgerbox.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 16:18:44 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: LedgerBox LLM ops & SLO commitments

Jonas — thanks for the thorough recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Burst profile: the 90 RPS bursts are tied to EOM processing windows and can last up to 45 minutes in worst case; can you size for 45m?
2) Token budget: we aim to keep average tokens/document under 700 (including prompt + response).
3) SOC2: we will start the evidence collection this week; can you send the SOC2 point of contact and a list of required artifacts?

Also — procurement: quick note that legal will request a data-flow diagram (we can redline a standard addendum) and a list of subprocessor locations.

If you can update the cost sketch with 45m burst sizing and 700 token budget that would be great. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of ML Ops | LedgerBox

-----End Original Message-----

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ledgerbox.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: LedgerBox LLM ops & SLO commitments

Priya — thanks, noted on the 45-minute worst-case burst and 700 token target. I updated the attached workbook (ledgerbox-kvcache-estimates.xlsx) with both sizes. Quick notes on how we modeled it: 

- Baseline pool: 6 x A100-80GB equivalent for steady 40 RPS with 2x headroom for modest autoscaling.
- Burst runway: burst pool sizing modeled as additional 5 instances for a 45-minute window; recommend enabling pre-warm policy for predictable cold-starts.
- Latency modeling: with our KV-cache hit estimate (30%) and continuous batching we model p95 model-forward latency at ~320 ms for a quantized 13B variant under the baseline.
- Cost note: Dedicated reserved pricing materially reduces unit cost; spreadsheet shows committed vs. on-demand columns.

Action items I’ll follow-up on in the next 48 hours:
- Full SLO latency budget breakdown (model-forward vs. infra vs. pre/post).
- Example canary plan (step sizes, health checks, expected metrics) and rollback triggers.
- SOC2 POC and evidence list (we’ll include the network/dataflow diagram).

I’ll drop an invite for Tue 26 May 2026 at 10am PT for the deep-dive unless you suggest an alternate.

Regards,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Internal note — tagging for ops/eng: 
- Karthik: can you review the burst instance recommendation and confirm we can support pre-warm for that size within the Dedicated offering? Also check whether autoscale cooldowns need to be adjusted to avoid oscillation with a 45m burst.
- Jonas: once Karthik confirms, please update the canary plan health checks to include KV-cache hit ratio and p99 tail latency gates.

Marissa
